after.scope: 141 exact workflow tests plus 4 independently authored regressions

closed_findings: Whole-report and original-input row inventory reject suppressed exclusions and altered coverage counters.
Malformed event/row containers are isolated; successful sibling outputs are retained.
verified_behaviors: Fit failure has source-bound coverage inventory without state or numeric forecasts.
Result reconciliation exclusion retains the original successful forecast and receipt.
Writer checks original source hash and reconstructs every input inventory row.
Generated reports and exclusions are separately hash-bound and checked after write.
limitations: Checksums and original-file reconstruction establish retained-byte integrity, not provider authentication if all source/package/receipt bytes are fabricated.
No predictive qualification, model promotion, protected integration, or action authority established.
